text: Newton contrasts absolute, true, and mathematical time with the sensible, external measure of duration by means of motion, which he calls relative, apparent, and ___ time.
explanation: Newton's fourfold contrast pairs 'absolute, true, and mathematical' time with 'relative, apparent, and common' time — the observable, measurable durations (an hour, a day, a year) used as practical standards. The expected word is 'common.' Newton does not deny relative/common time; he insists it is only an approximation to the true absolute time.
